# Crunchbase

Crunchbase provides company, people, funding, financial, prediction, and market insight data through its package-entitled Enterprise API.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/crunchbase/.

## Actions

- **Autocomplete Entities** (read-only): Suggest Crunchbase entity identifiers and permalinks matching text, optionally limited to documented or key-entitled collections.
- **Get Entity** (read-only): Get one Crunchbase entity by collection and UUID or permalink, selecting licensed fields and optionally embedded relationship cards.
- **Get Fields Metadata** (read-only): Return the connected Crunchbase key's licensed collections and field definitions, optionally filtered by collection.
- **Get OpenAPI Specification** (read-only): Return the Crunchbase REST v4 OpenAPI surface licensed to the connected key in JSON or YAML.
- **List Deleted Entities** (read-only): List Crunchbase deletion records across supported collections or for one collection, with forward or backward keyset pagination.
- **List Entity Card** (read-only): List one Crunchbase entity relationship card with selected licensed fields and one-page forward or backward keyset pagination.
- **Search Entities** (read-only): Search one Crunchbase collection using licensed fields, up to 25 AND-combined predicates, ordering, and one-page keyset pagination.
